support_policies.rule: Enterprise priority tickets require first response within 30 minutes and manager escalation when severity is high or impact affects production users.
Customer-facing replies must cite an approved KB article, account fact, incident statement, or approved internal note.
Role, permission, region, plan, domain, or owner changes require a human approval packet before mutation.
Refunds above 50 USD, any annual-plan credit, or goodwill credits require finance or customer-success approval.

knowledge_base.title: Troubleshooting SSO login failures
knowledge_base.summary: Check IdP certificate validity, ACS URL, clock skew, and user assignment before escalating to identity engineering.

knowledge_base.title: Plan-change proration policy
knowledge_base.summary: Mid-cycle plan upgrades prorate immediately; downgrades apply at renewal unless customer-success approves an exception.

knowledge_base.title: API rate-limit troubleshooting
knowledge_base.summary: Confirm tenant limit, burst capacity, retry headers, and recent incident status before recommending exponential backoff.

incident_log.impact: Elevated 429s for a subset of API tenants in us region.
incident_log.approvedStatement: We identified elevated API throttling and applied mitigation. Retries should now succeed; we are monitoring error rates.
